articles.title: Rare sight: Sukhois, Rafales, American F35s, Tejas fly in formations over Indian airspace
articles.summary: During an Indian Air Force (IAF) exercise over Rajasthan, a significant display of aerial interoperability occurred. Russian-acquired Sukhois, American F-35s, and French Rafales shared the same airspace alongside India's indigenous Tejas fighter jets. This event, part of an IAF drill, highlights India's strategic military partnerships and its capability to operate and integrate diverse international defence platforms within its operational framework.

articles.title: Discover Tenerife wine that’s aged 18m under the Atlantic
articles.summary: Bodegas Monjes produces 'Tradicional Submarino,' a red wine featuring a unique aging process. Crafted from local grapes grown in volcanic soil, it is submerged 18 meters deep in the Atlantic Ocean for five to six months. The wine is then retrieved and uncorked, suggesting distinct characteristics developed from this innovative underwater maturation. This method exemplifies a novel approach to viticulture.
